mechanism.claim: The rolling empirical copula of BTC and six liquid alt perpetuals identifies whether system-wide extreme dependence is stronger in the upper or lower tail. During elevated BTC variation, a completed BTC tail move aligned with the unusually dominant joint tail is followed for eight hours.
mechanism.side: long for unusually upper-dominant dependence plus a current BTC upper-tail block; short for the lower-tail analogue
mechanism.why_distinct: prior cross-alt candidates used contemporaneous breadth, mean returns, residuals, flow, funding, volume, or leadership; no repository candidate estimates rolling empirical upper-versus-lower co-exceedance dependence
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: a sparse copula-asymmetry onset has no primitive or fixed clock in Gross9

source_contract.row_validity: unique exact UTC minute; finite positive OHLC; high>=max(open,close), low<=min(open,close), high>=low
source_contract.block_validity: exact 240 rows for every symbol in half-open UTC four-hour block; any missing or invalid row invalidates the whole block
source_contract.causal_availability: block features are available at block end; decision at block end and entry at block end+5m
source_contract.transport: read-only PostgreSQL query with SQL hash, physical row count, normalized panel hash, and no imputation
source_contract.revision_boundary: database snapshot hashes freeze this replay vintage; no historical first-seen revision archive is claimed
source_contract.bounded_probe_disclosure: only table schema and per-symbol min/max/count metadata were opened; no candidate feature, incidence, post-entry outcome, or Gross9 row was read

feature_contract.block_return: log(last close / first open) for each exact valid four-hour block
feature_contract.tail_dependence_history: at most 270 and at least 180 immediately prior valid joint blocks; current excluded
feature_contract.empirical_tail_cutoffs: within the current history, strict empirical midranks with lower<=0.20 and upper>=0.80
feature_contract.per_alt_upper_dependence: count(prior BTC upper and alt upper) divided by count(prior BTC upper)
feature_contract.per_alt_lower_dependence: count(prior BTC lower and alt lower) divided by count(prior BTC lower)
feature_contract.tail_asymmetry: mean six upper-dependences minus mean six lower-dependences; strict nonzero
feature_contract.asymmetry_magnitude_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(tail_asymmetry), at most 270 finite earlier values and minimum 180
feature_contract.current_btc_tail: BTC current block-return midrank against the same prior joint history; upper>=0.80 or lower<=0.20
feature_contract.btc_variation: sum squared close-to-close BTC log returns over exact 1,440 completed 1m rows ending at block end
feature_contract.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior 270/180 midrank across valid joint blocks
feature_contract.eligible_state: asymmetry_magnitude_rank>=0.80 and btc_variation_rank>=0.65 and either tail_asymmetry>0 with current_btc_tail>=0.80 or tail_asymmetry<0 with current_btc_tail<=0.20
feature_contract.onset: current joint block eligible and immediately previous joint block ineligible

oos_clock.reservation: chronological first eligible onset while flat; half-open intervals and exit first on equal time

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, favorable-then-adverse held 5m path, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged passes every sequential economic stage

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent empirical-copula tail-dependence mechanism fixed before incidence or outcomes

stopping_rule: freeze preregistration, source support, Gross9 novelty, and sequential economics; terminal first failure with no universe, block, history, tail, rank, volatility gate, onset, side, delay, hold, subset, or control repair
